text:
nina_cs: FYI from todays WillowEdge onboarding: their chat latency spikes around 09:00-10:00 PST (p95 ~2.6s, 600-1000 token responses). They're on rwd-llama-lite-7b (fp16). Renewal flagged: high usage, customer concerned about UX. Proposing a quick experiment: int8 quant + time-of-day routing to a compact 7B-6k variant during peak. Thoughts?

raj_se: Sounds good. Quick checklist: 1) run offline semantic-safety eval on int8 build, 2) enable prefix caching for identical system prompts, 3) set conservative canary (3-5%) and monitor.

fiona_ml: Agree. Also add a 200-prompt fidelity check (customer-critical utterances). Int8 typically drops cost ~25-35% and reduces p95 by ~40-60% in our infra for this family. Watch for tokenization edgecases + temperature drift.

kevin_pm: Can we get an estimate to share with WillowEdge? They want expected p95, cost delta, and rollback plan in a 1-paragraph blurb before tomorrows check-in.

raj_se: Quick config we can push via route API: 

```
{
  "name": "we-quant-peak-canary",
  "canary": 0.03,
  "models": [
    {"id": "rwd-llama-lite-7b-6k-quant-int8", "weight": 0.03},
    {"id": "rwd-llama-lite-7b-16k", "weight": 0.97}
  ],
  "time_based_weights": [
    {"start": "09:00", "end": "10:30", "compact_weight": 0.20}
  ],
  "batching_ms": 15,
  "prefix_cache": true
}
```

raj_se: We'll gate expansion (5% -> 20%) after 48h if p95 improved and fidelity delta <= 0.01 (automated eval).

fiona_ml: Add regression triggers: fail if human-eval pass rate < 0.96 on the 200-prompt set or if hallucination rate increases by >0.5%. Also exclude flagged flows (billing/legal) from canary routing.

nina_cs: I'll tell the customer the expected numbers: p95 from 2.6s -> ~1.1s, cost per 1k tokens down ~30%. Caveat: slight chance of generation variance; well run human spot-checks and can rollback instantly.

kevin_pm: I'll draft the blurb and share by 4pm PST. Include contact points and a one-click rollback note.

deploy-bot: Preview deploy created: https://console.redwood.ai/deploy/previews/we-quant-1795123456 (logs available).

raj_se: Ill add a short runbook with curl snippets and telemetry dashboard links: https://redwoodops/internal/we-quant-runbook (admins only). Example curl to create route: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @we-quant-config.json
```

nina_cs: Action items: raj -> push canary + runbook; fiona -> eval results by EOD; kevin -> customer blurb; i'll run customer check-in tomorrow 09:30 PST.

fiona_ml: Will run the 200-prompt diff and upload examples. If regressions >1% but <3% we do a manual review on 50 examples.

nina_cs: thanks team :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1795123620. Live logs: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/canary/1795123620

raj_se: ack, monitoring p50/p95/p99, token-cost, and quality delta on the dashboard.

nina_cs: Ill update WillowEdge after the first 2h observation window. "
